# avd-ops: avd-ops docs

> Onboarding and user docs for the AVD repos: what each one does, how they fit together, and where
> to start.

The knowledge base is in docs/knowledge/. Every page starts with YAML front matter (title, summary,
topic, status, last_reviewed) validated against docs/knowledge/schema/. Pages with status `plan`
describe intended work, not facts, and claims marked *unverified* are not yet confirmed. To
contribute, open a KB feedback or known-error issue; changes land only through reviewed pull requests.

## Knowledge base

- [Knowledge base](docs/knowledge/README.md): What this knowledge base is, how it's organised, and how to add to it safely (status: partial)
- [Start here](docs/knowledge/getting-started/README.md): What the AVD repos do, which one to open first, and how to try them safely in a lab (status: partial)
- [Working from Cloud Shell](docs/knowledge/getting-started/cloud-shell.md): The conventions every AVD repo follows for Azure Cloud Shell: one self-contained block, pinned sources, nothing kept in the shell, one sign-in, redact before sharing, tear down with evidence (status: partial)
- [Concepts](docs/knowledge/concepts/README.md): The ideas the AVD repos share: lifecycle stages, contracts, read-first agents, tenant data boundaries and knowledge capture (status: partial)
- [Sandbox batches](docs/knowledge/concepts/sandbox-batches.md): How test runs that cost money are queued, priced, approved once at an exact total, run one after another, and torn down with evidence (status: partial)
- [The repos](docs/knowledge/repos/README.md): Each AVD repo, its lifecycle stage and where to read more; every repo is the source of truth for itself (status: partial)
- [avd-assess](docs/knowledge/repos/avd-assess.md): Foundation, what it should be: an open AVD assessment methodology that links pinned published sources and adds what real runs observed (status: partial)
- [avd-azure](docs/knowledge/repos/avd-azure.md): Control plane: cloud-native Azure ARM and Bicep infrastructure for Azure Virtual Desktop, Private Link, FSLogix Azure Files and session hosts (status: partial)
- [avd-current-state](docs/knowledge/repos/avd-current-state.md): What is there now: read-only PowerShell that collects an AVD environment, validates it and writes redacted C11 facts (status: partial)
- [avd-entra](docs/knowledge/repos/avd-entra.md): Control plane: Entra ID security groups, dynamic session-host groups, Conditional Access and Entra Kerberos for Azure Virtual Desktop (status: plan)
- [avd-intune](docs/knowledge/repos/avd-intune.md): Control plane: Microsoft Intune session-host MDM enrollment, Settings Catalog baselines and compliance policies for Azure Virtual Desktop (status: plan)
- [avd-landing-zone](docs/knowledge/repos/avd-landing-zone.md): How it's built and changed from here: a cloud-native AVD landing zone and deployment portal for multiple pools, workspaces and Private Link (status: partial)
- [avd-m365](docs/knowledge/repos/avd-m365.md): Control plane: greenfield Microsoft 365 tenant, OneDrive Known Folder Move, Teams VDI optimization and M365 Apps baselines (status: plan)
- [avd-power-platform](docs/knowledge/repos/avd-power-platform.md): Control plane: Power Platform environments, DLP policies and Power Automate day-2 workflows for Azure Virtual Desktop (status: plan)
- [avd-second-brain](docs/knowledge/repos/avd-second-brain.md): On top, the why: the knowledge base, contract registry and fact register over the environment's life (status: partial)
- [avd-swarm](docs/knowledge/repos/avd-swarm.md): On top, the how of operating: agents that read freely and change nothing until a person approves the plan (status: partial)
- [Known errors](docs/knowledge/troubleshooting/README.md): Errors hit in this project: symptom, cause, fix and source (status: partial)
- [Roadmap](docs/knowledge/roadmap/README.md): Where each AVD repo is today and what these docs will cover next (status: plan)
- [Keeping the knowledge base current](docs/knowledge/curation.md): How the KB stays current: the weekly digest, the prior-art check, the feedback loop, the freshness check and family alignment (status: verified)
- [Experts we follow](docs/knowledge/experts.md): How we choose which people on this KB's topics the KB follows: the method, the scores and the list (status: verified)

## Structured data

- [Known errors](docs/knowledge/troubleshooting/known-errors.yaml): symptom, cause, fix and source for errors hit in this project
- [Field reports](docs/knowledge/field-reports.yaml): what worked or broke when someone followed the KB
- [Experts study](docs/knowledge/experts.yaml): people the KB follows, with scores, evidence and the feeds watched
- [Family](docs/knowledge/family.yaml): the sibling knowledge bases and the format version each follows
- [Schemas](docs/knowledge/schema/page.schema.json): JSON Schemas for page front matter and the YAML files above

## Decisions

- [0001. Adopt the 2ndbrain knowledge base format, version 1](docs/knowledge/decisions/0001-adopt-the-2ndbrain-format.md): accepted
- [0002. avd-ops is the front door for the AVD repos](docs/knowledge/decisions/0002-avd-ops-is-the-front-door.md): accepted
- [0003. The family ends at its contracts; work outside it builds on them, never the reverse](docs/knowledge/decisions/0003-the-family-ends-at-its-contracts.md): proposed
- [0004. Every outside submission is a GitHub issue form in the repo that owns it](docs/knowledge/decisions/0004-submissions-are-github-issue-forms.md): accepted
- [0005. One app shell for every avd-ops page, vendored as a pinned copy](docs/knowledge/decisions/0005-one-app-shell-for-every-page.md): accepted
- [0006. Every operator script runs from either Cloud Shell prompt and on Windows, macOS and Linux](docs/knowledge/decisions/0006-run-anywhere.md): accepted
- [0007. The theme ships as starters and a brand profile in avd-ops, not as its own repo or package](docs/knowledge/decisions/0007-starters-not-a-theme-repo.md): proposed
- [0008. Family scripts ship as attested, immutable releases; Authenticode only where Windows enforces it](docs/knowledge/decisions/0008-code-signing.md): accepted
- [0009. Split deployment into five control-plane repos orchestrated by avd-landing-zone](docs/knowledge/decisions/0009-split-landing-zone-into-five-control-planes.md): accepted

## Related knowledge bases

- [2ndbrain](https://github.com/nickprignano/2ndbrain/tree/main/docs/knowledge): The template that owns the family knowledge base format. Source of truth for: the family knowledge base format; its scripts and schemas
- [AVD](https://github.com/avd-ops/avd-second-brain/tree/main/docs/knowledge): Azure Virtual Desktop itself, across its lifecycle (assess, inventory, deploy, operate), and the intelligence layer behind avd-swarm. Source of truth for: Azure Virtual Desktop platform; FSLogix; session host images in general; the AVD landing zone and its operations; the contracts between the AVD repos
- [Liquidware](https://github.com/nickprignano/avd-liquidware/tree/main/docs/knowledge): Liquidware products on virtual desktops, starting with Stratusphere UX in Azure. Source of truth for: Liquidware products; Stratusphere UX appliances; the Liquidware tier for the landing zone

## Optional

- [Curator sources](docs/knowledge/sources.toml): the feeds and repos the weekly digest watches
